units.name: Department of Mechanical & Industrial Engineering
units.evidence: Current official department homepage names Mechanical & Industrial Engineering. Its current graduate programme page explicitly offers a PhD in Industrial Engineering; mechanical and industrial tracks are distinct. Original fact and source date preserved.

decisions.reason: The OM List source assertion is the parent institution as a reported PhD location, without a department or school label. LSU's official school and engineering menus establish the separate current ISE department, but the individual reported doctorate cannot be assigned to it from the parent-only label.
